title: Fake Graduation Photographer
scenario: A social account asks for deposit for graduation photos and disappears after payment.

answers.A: Verify inside the official university/account system.
answers.B: Click/apply/pay quickly before the deadline passes.
answers.C: Contact the relevant office using published contact details.
answers.D: Reply to the message and ask the sender for proof.

explanation: Fake Graduation Photographer: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Book through verified photographers or campus listings.
